description: A rack tidier: dragging its panel moves the whole row of modules it stands in, and its other zones insert empty rows or cycle the rows in and out of view
notes: drag the middle of the panel to move the whole row of modules sideways or into another row.
the top and bottom zones of the panel insert an empty row above and below this one.
the two zones between them cycle every row above or every row below into view, which saves scrolling in a tall rack.
the panel carries no jacks and no parameters, so none of it can be clicked for its own note; every zone is part of one panel.
menu: add new rows here instead of upper/lower — inserts the new empty row at this module's own row rather than above or below it
strip mode (default by holding ctrl/cmd while moving) — drags this module and everything to its right as one block, and moves it between rows, without holding a key
